headline: Case 04 ARI: no trade. Real discount, wrong tool. QUANT stopped it.
reasoning: SCOUT: liquidation, $4.10 paid Oct 29, last trade Nov 6, estimated 7.75-8.50 total by 2028
ANALYST: long for a 21-33% gross discount to the estimate, realized only by holding into 2028
SKEPTIC: let it through with three objections; the discount is the price of illiquidity
QUANT: objected. The ex-date drop fires any stop, the paper account would book a fake loss, and nothing can be held past Nov 6
Lesson for SCOUT: skip liquidations with a large distribution or a delisting date inside the holding window
Check: ARI price into Oct 29 and Nov 6; size of the second liquidating distribution when declared
objections: SCOUT: only the delisting date is new (open)
QUANT: cannot be expressed as a bracket order (case ended)
